desc: Kingfisher spirit: lavender hooded cloak body with small wing flaps, long pale gold beak-shaped mask, gold feather crest. Mythical spirit creature, not a real animal, cool but cute chibi, right-facing 3/4, full body. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Round black void face with two small white dot eyes. Lavender, white, violet, gold. No halo, no sparkles, no shadow.
